name: Tsubata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsubata town emblem in green: an outlined ring enclosing a winged device with a stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Tsubata, a town in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 January 1966.

features.role: Tsubata town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a winged device with a stylised mountain
